description: Seed registry for DimTechnologies, TechnologyAlias and TechnologyDependency. 'name' is the canonical value for DimTechnologies.name. 'aliases' are surface forms mapped to it; they are globally unique and never collide with another canonical name. 'parents' means 'knowing this implies knowing that' (react implies javascript), and loads into TechnologyDependency as child_id -> parent_id. 'concepts' means 'operating this implies knowing that' (sql server implies relational databases), and loads into TechnologyConcept; only implications that always hold, since a false edge inflates every match. 'category' has no column in schema.sql yet; keep it or drop it at load time.
